Features Installation Key Features in Action System Architecture For Developers Meetily PRO Contributing License Introduction Meetily is a privacy-first AI meeting assistant that runs entirely on your local machine. It captures your meetings, transcribes them in real-time, and generates summaries, all without sending any data to the cloud. This makes it the perfect solution for professionals and enterprises who need to maintain complete control over their sensitive information. Why Meetily? While there are many meeting transcription tools available, this solution stands out by offering: Privacy First: All processing happens locally on your device. Cost-Effective: Uses open-source AI models instead of expensive APIs. Flexible: Works offline and supports multiple meeting platforms. Customizable: Self-host and modify for your specific needs. The Privacy Problem Meeting AI tools create significant privacy and compliance risks across all sectors: $4.4M average cost per data breach (IBM 2024) €5.88 billion in GDPR fines issued by 2025 400+ unlawful recording cases filed in California this year Whether you're a defense consultant, enterprise executive, legal professional, or healthcare provider, your sensitive discussions shouldn't live on servers you don't control. Cloud meeting tools promise convenience but deliver privacy nightmares with unclear data storage practices and potential unauthorized access. Meetily solves this: Complete data sovereignty on your infrastructure, zero vendor lock-in, and full control over your sensitive conversations. Features Local First: All processing is done on your machine. No data ever leaves your computer. Real-time Transcription: Get a live transcript of your meeting as it happens. AI-Powered Summaries: Generate summaries of your meetings using powerful language models. Multi-Platform: Works on macOS, Windows, and Linux. Open Source: Meetily is open source and free to use. Flexible AI Provider Support: Choose from Ollama (local), Claude, Groq, OpenRouter, or use your own OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Installation 🪟 Windows Download the latest x64-setup.exe from Releases Run the installer 🍎 macOS Download meetily_0.4.0_aarch64.dmg from Releases Open the downloaded .dmg file Drag Meetily to your Applications folder Open Meetily from Applications folder 🐧 Linux Build from source following our detailed guides: Building on Linux General Build Instructions Quick start: git clone https://github.com/Zackriya-Solutions/meeting-minutes cd meeting-minutes/frontend pnpm install ./build-gpu.sh Key Features in Action 🎯 Local Transcription Transcribe meetings entirely on your device using Whisper or Parakeet models. No cloud required. 📥 Import & Enhance Beta Import existing audio files to generate transcripts, or enhance to re-transcribe any recorded meeting with a different model or language, all processed locally. Contributed by Jeremi Joslin, improved by Vishnu P S and Mohammed Safvan 🤖 AI-Powered Summaries Generate meeting summaries with your choice of AI provider. Ollama (local) is recommended, with support for Claude, Groq, OpenRouter, and OpenAI. 🔒 Privacy-First Design All data stays on your machine. Transcription models, recordings, and transcripts are stored locally. 🌐 Custom OpenAI Endpoint Support Use your own OpenAI-compatible endpoint for AI summaries. Perfect for organizations with custom AI infrastructure or preferred providers. 🎙️ Professional Audio Mixing Capture microphone and system audio simultaneously with intelligent ducking and clipping prevention. ⚡ GPU Acceleration Built-in support for hardware acceleration across platforms: macOS: Apple Silicon (Metal) + CoreML Windows/Linux: NVIDIA (CUDA), AMD/Intel (Vulkan) Automatically enabled at build time - no configuration needed. System Architecture Meetily is a single, self-contained application built with Tauri. It uses a Rust-based backend to handle all the core logic, and a Next.js frontend for the user interface. For more details, see the Architecture documentation. For Developers If you want to contribute to Meetily or build it from source, you'll need to have Rust and Node.js installed. For detailed build instructions, please see the Building from Source guide. tech_assessment.architecture_highlights: 基于 Tauri（Rust 后端 + Next.js 前端）构建的单体桌面应用，采用全本地化处理架构。核心亮点包括：① 双转录模型引擎（Whisper / Parakeet），用户可根据精度与性能需求切换；② 多层 AI 摘要后端抽象层，支持 Ollama（本地）、Claude、Groq、OpenRouter 及任意 OpenAI 兼容端点，实现 AI 供应商零锁定；③ 跨平台硬件加速管线（macOS Metal + CoreML、NVIDIA CUDA、AMD/Intel Vulkan），确保本地 AI 推理在消费级设备上的实时性；④ 系统音频捕获模块内置智能闪避（ducking）与防削波（clipping prevention）机制，保障多音源场景下的录制质量。各组件通过标准化接口解耦，Tauri 的 Rust IPC 层负责前后端通信，架构层次清晰、可替换性强。
tech_assessment.dependencies_analysis: 核心依赖栈：Tauri（Rust 原生 GUI 框架）→ Next.js（React 前端渲染）→ Whisper / Parakeet（开源语音转文字模型）→ Ollama（本地 LLM 推理引擎）。可选外部依赖：Claude / Groq / OpenRouter / OpenAI API（用于 AI 摘要生成，非必需）。底层硬件加速：Metal Performance Shaders（macOS）、CUDA（NVIDIA）、Vulkan（AMD/Intel）。整体架构耦合度较低——AI 后端通过统一抽象接口集成，转录模型可互换，前端与后端通过 Tauri IPC 通信。对本地 ML 推理框架的依赖较深，但均基于开源生态（Whisper、Ollama），无专有技术锁定风险。

title: crynta/terax-ai
description: Lightweight (7MB) Terminal-first AI-native dev workspace Terax Lightweight Terminal-first AI-native dev workspace. Website · Docs · Website's source code Terax is a lightweight open-source terminal (ADE) built on Tauri 2 + Rust and React 19. A native PTY backend with a WebGL renderer, an agentic AI side-panel that runs against your own keys or fully local models, plus a code editor, file explorer, source control with a git graph, and a web preview pane built in. About 7-8 MB on disk. No telemetry. No account. Screenshots Multi-tab terminal with WebGL rendering Custom themes, presets, and background images Web preview of local dev servers Source control panel with git graph in history Agentic AI workflow with edit diffs in the code editor Features Terminal xterm.js with WebGL renderer, multi-tab with background streaming GPU-accelerated block-based terminal with editor-like command input Native PTY backend via portable-pty (zsh, bash, pwsh, fish, cmd) Split panels (horizontal and vertical) Inline search, link detection, true-color Per-tab workspace environments on Windows (Local, or any installed WSL distro) Code editor CodeMirror 6 (supports all popular languages - TS/JS, Rust, Python, Go, C/C++, Java, HTML/CSS, JSON, Markdown, etc.) Inline AI autocomplete with local model support AI edit diffs, accept or reject hunk by hunk Vim mode Ten built-in editor themes: Atom One, Aura, Copilot, GitHub Dark / Light, Gruvbox Dark, Nord, Tokyo Night, Xcode Dark / Light Source control Stage / unstage hunks, commit (Cmd+Enter / Ctrl+Enter), push with upstream awareness Branch display including detached HEAD state Git history pane with a real commit graph (lane rendering for merges and branches) Commit search and filter, click through to the remote commit page File explorer Catppuccin icon theme Fuzzy search, keyboard navigation, inline rename, context actions Attach files and selections directly to the AI side-panel Web preview Auto-detects local dev servers and opens them in a preview tab External URL preview via a native child webview Themes and customization Custom themes built in-app, switch between bundled presets and your own Create your own themes, share them or import from the community Background images with adjustable opacity and blur Editor theme is independent from the app theme AI BYOK providers: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google (Gemini), Groq, xAI (Grok), Cerebras, OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Mistral, plus any OpenAI-compatible endpoint Local / offline: LM Studio, MLX, Ollama Agentic workflow: plans, sub-agents, project memory via TERAX.md, file read / write / edit / multi-edit / grep / glob, bash with approval gating, background processes Composer: snippets via #handle, files via @path, slash commands, voice input, attach-to-agent from explorer or selection Custom agents with their own system prompt and tool subset Plan mode for multi-step work, generates and confirms before doing Install Latest installers are on the Releases page. Terax auto-updates from there. Windows notes On first launch Windows shows "Windows protected your PC" because Terax isn't code-signed yet. Click More info then Run anyway. Default shell detection: pwsh.exe (PowerShell 7+) -> powershell.exe (Windows PowerShell 5.1) -> cmd.exe. WSL is a first-class workspace environment, not a wrapped subprocess. Linux notes Arch / AUR: yay -S terax-bin (or paru, etc.). Tracks the latest release. NixOS / Nix: use the official flake — nix profile install github:crynta/terax-ai (non-NixOS), or import the flake and add inputs.terax.packages.${pkgs.system}.terax to environment.systemPackages (NixOS). The nixosModules.terax output is also available for a simpler setup. AppImage: needs FUSE. Without it: ./Terax_*.AppImage --appimage-extract-and-run. On Wayland with rendering glitches, try WEBKIT_DISABLE_DMABUF_RENDERER=1. Otherwise the .deb / .rpm packages link against the system GTK stack and tend to be smoother. Configure AI Open Settings -> AI. Pick a provider and paste your API key. For local inference, point Terax at your LM Studio / MLX / Ollama endpoint. Keys are written to the OS keychain via keyring. They never touch disk or localStorage. compound_value.reason: 该项目是一个个人开发者主导的开源音乐播放器，核心价值在于全屏歌词沉浸体验和 AI 主题生成，但缺乏可持续的商业模式和团队支撑。从 VC 视角看，音乐播放器赛道高度拥挤且用户付费意愿集中在 Spotify/Apple Music 等巨头，Folia 作为 AGPL-3.0 开源项目难以构建商业闭环。AI 能力仅停留在基于歌曲情绪的配色/背景生成，技术护城河极浅。唯一值得关注的长期价值在于其 Web 端可一键部署至 Vercel 的模式可能催生极简音乐流媒体自建站生态，但规模天花板明显，难以形成复利效应。

market_opportunities: AI主题生成能力（基于歌曲情绪与歌词自动生成视觉背景与配色）可作为独立模块商业化，面向音乐流媒体平台、播客工具、直播平台提供B2B视觉自动化服务
全屏沉浸式歌词动画+AI视觉的融合模式可被泛娱乐应用（如K歌App、虚拟偶像直播、在线演唱会）借鉴，提升用户沉浸式体验，形成差异化的产品卖点
开源+多平台部署（Vercel Web端/Electron桌面端）的架构模式，为个人开发者和独立团队提供了一种低成本的AI应用分发参考范式，可复制至其他创意工具类产品

risk_matrix.regulatory: 项目通过在线方式获取网易云音乐等平台的歌词、封面及流媒体资源，存在版权侵权风险。AGPL-3.0许可证的强传染性可能被商业使用者忽视或规避，导致法律纠纷。AI主题生成中处理歌词内容可能涉及数据合规与著作权问题。
risk_matrix.technological: Electron技术栈在移动端和低性能设备上面临性能与电池续航挑战。依赖于第三方音乐平台（网易云、Navidrome）的非官方API或爬取接口，存在被封禁或变更的风险。LRC/LDDC歌词格式可能随流媒体行业标准演进而被边缘化。
risk_matrix.competitive: Spotify、Apple Music、网易云音乐等主流平台已内嵌歌词显示功能且具备巨大用户基数。开源领域存在Feishin、Sonixd等同类音乐播放器项目，Folia需在AI主题和歌词动画差异化上持续投入才能维持竞争力。Web端部署至Vercel的免费额度有限，大规模使用会产生基础设施成本。
risk_matrix.ethical: 自动匹配和展示歌词及封面涉及对版权内容的未经授权使用与再分发。AI主题生成可能基于歌词内容产生不恰当的视觉呈现（如涉及暴力、歧视性或敏感政治内容的视觉化）。用户本地音乐索引信息安全性依赖于设备自身防护，项目本身未强调端到端加密。
additional: 项目声明"在 AI 的广泛协助下开发"，代码质量和安全性需经社区审计验证，可能存在不易察觉的漏洞或逻辑缺陷
免责声明称版权责任由使用者承担，但在中国法律框架下平台运营者可能仍需承担间接侵权责任，项目维护者面临潜在诉讼风险

object_insights.name: chthollyphile/folia-major
object_insights.positioning: 全屏沉浸式歌词播放器，支持网易云、Navidrome和本地音乐库三种音乐源，通过AI主题生成与多种全屏歌词动画提供独特听歌体验。
object_insights.technical_signal: 项目集成智能歌词匹配、LRC/LDDC逐字歌词识别、Now Playing外部播放器接入，以及基于Electron的跨平台桌面端架构。
object_insights.adoption_signal: 项目在GitHub开源并提供了详细的部署文档与使用指南，支持一键部署到Vercel，降低了用户使用门槛。
object_insights.ecosystem_relevance: 作为开源全屏歌词播放器，在沉浸式听歌体验领域具有差异化定位，与主流音乐平台形成互补而非替代关系。
object_insights.watch_reason: Folia以全屏沉浸式歌词播放为核心创新点，结合AI主题生成与六种歌词动画，在开源音乐播放器领域具有差异化定位，值得持续关注其用户增长与技术演进。
risk_notes: 项目依赖第三方音乐平台API（网易云等），存在接口变动或合规风险。
版权声明要求仅供个人学习与非营利测试使用，可能限制商业化发展空间。
evidence_snippets: Folia是一个以全屏沉浸式歌词播放为核心的在线音乐播放器，支持网易云，navidrome和本地音乐库。
通过智能歌词匹配，AI生成配色主题，以及多种全屏歌词动画为用户提供独特的听歌体验。
如果希望直接开箱即用，马上体验，推荐直接使用基于Electron的 windows/ macOS/ Linux 桌面端版本。

object_insights.name: Apple Music-like Lyrics TTML

object_insights.technical_signal: 采用TTML（定时文本标记语言）格式实现逐字级别的高精度歌词同步数据。
object_insights.ecosystem_relevance: 作为Folia等开源播放器的歌词数据上游，为全屏沉浸式歌词显示提供精准的歌词文件支撑。
object_insights.watch_reason: 作为开源逐字歌词数据源项目，为Folia等音乐播放器提供高质量的TTML歌词文件，是沉浸式听歌体验中重要的基础设施层项目。
risk_notes: 歌词数据可能涉及音乐版权问题，项目在法律合规方面存在潜在风险。
evidence_snippets: 本项目接入了 Apple Music-like Lyrics TTML 逐字歌词库 以提供高质量的歌词文件，感谢此歌词库的作者和贡献者们。
